'''Halina Patel''' was a gifted [[Slicer/Legends|slicer]] and [[intelligence analyst]] who worked for the [[Imperial Security Bureau/Legends|Imperial Security Bureau]]. [[Gender/Legends|She]] had a [[cybernetic computer interface]] implanted in her head.<ref name="GeharrIncident" />
